summary: Iteration 137 Misfire frontend regression PASS. Verified Home card, Misfire 'Sab' tab, all 7 family tabs, JEE PYQ paper card, Paper page, Solve screen with MCQ + integer numpad, 'Aur dikhao' pagination, 'Poora analysis' and 'Paper ka result' links into /result/<id> with result-tab-solutions present, and the AITS regression (home-tile-live → /live → series-open-analysis-list → /series-analysis → series-analysis-misfire → /misfire?tab=aits with misfire-paper-fx-live-10). All writes were intercepted by fake_misfire_writes; the only POSTs that fired were 'try {"value":"A"}', 'try {"value":"B"}', 'done {}', 'reopen {}' and all were handled by the fake (no real write reached /api/jl/my/misfire/*). No page errors, no red screen, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 320 on Home or Misfire. Integer question Q21 showed numpad with keys 0-9, minus, back and no dot; typed 4,2 → '42', minus → '-42', back → '-4'. Chapter report showed '1 paper milakar' and chapter-report-no-chapters. Fixed mode showed misfire-empty. All family tabs (aits, jee-chapter, bitsat-mock, bitsat-chapter, comedk-mock) showed misfire-papers-empty; JEE PYQ showed exactly one paper (1ea510f2…).

No real writes reached /api/jl/my/misfire/*; posts intercepted by fake handler only
notes: Error-box check: after routing **/api/jl/my/misfire** to 500 AFTER cached data was already loaded, misfire-error did not render because the cache served the stored summary. This is expected behavior of useCached (stale-while-revalidate) and not a regression. Not flagged as a bug.
In the first test the Check karo button was labeled aria-disabled='true' (not an HTML disabled attr). This is correct RN web behavior.

Only 'result-tab-solutions' was probed by explicit testID in this run; other result tabs exist on the screen (visually present in /result/<id>) and were not probed beyond solutions which was the main concern of this story.
